title: Bie-Jia-Jian Pill: Inhibiting tumor glycolysis and promoting CD8(+) cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity by targeting HIF-1alpha-PI3K/AKT/mTOR and CCL20 in hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Liu, Yang; Yang, Xuemei; Qin, Mengchen; Chen, Weicong; Liu, Changshun; Jiang, Wentao; Wang, Yiqin; Tan, Sirui; Sun, Haiyan; Chen, Jingfei; Sun, Haitao; He, Songqi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药鳖甲煎丸通过HIF-1alpha-PI3K/AKT/mTOR轴抑制肝癌糖酵解并增强CD8+T细胞抗肿瘤免疫，属于纯湿实验与代谢/免疫机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The efficacy of immunotherapy for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is often limited by an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME), largely driven by tumor metabolic reprogramming (the Warburg effect) that impairs CD8(+) T cells. Targeting this metabolism to restore immunity is a promising strategy. Bie-Jia-Jian Pill (BJJP), a traditional formula for "softening hardness and dissipating masses," conceptually aligns with modulating the TME. However, its role in reprogramming tumor metabolism to enhance immunotherapy remains unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: We aimed to investigate if BJJP enhances anti-tumor immunity by inhibiting the Warburg effect, elucidate its molecular mechanism, and evaluate its synergy with PD-L1 blockade. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Using UHPLC-MS, the major components of BJJP were analyzed and its efficacy was evaluated in combination with the PD-L1 neutralizing antibody for HCC treatment. CD8(+) T cells and tumor markers were assessed in vitro and in vivo using flow cytometry. Transcriptomics, metabolomics, Seahorse metabolic assays, Western blotting, ELISA, and immunofluorescence staining were employed to identify and validate the mechanisms and targets of BJJP. Its targeting capabilities were confirmed by lentivirus and siRNA transfections, network pharmacology and molecular docking. RESULTS: BJJP suppressed HCC cell proliferation, growth and migration, promoted their apoptosis, reduced PD-L1 expression, and enhanced CD8(+) T cell cytotoxicity and infiltration in the tumor. BJJP and immunotherapy exerted synergistic effects, including inhibiting tumor cell proliferation, increasing immune cell infiltration, and improving treatment efficacy. BJJP suppressed glycolysis in HCC cells, alleviated the excessive uptake of energy substrates, and reduced lactate accumulation in the microenvironment, thereby mitigating CD8(+) T cell exhaustion. This glycolytic metabolic reprogramming was related to BJJP's effect on inhibiting the HIF-1alpha-PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis. Additionally, BJJP inhibited the downstream NF-kappaB activation, down-regulated CCL20, and alleviated the inhibitory effect of CCL20 against CD8(+) T cells. CONCLUSION: BJJP targets the HIF-1alpha-PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis to reprogram tumor glycolysis, reduce CCL20 secretion, enhance CD8(+) T cell immune response, and modulate the tumor microenvironment, thereby exerting anti-tumor effects against HCC. When used in combination with immunotherapy, BJJP can improve treatment efficacy, providing valuable evidence for clinical treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：肝细胞癌（HCC）免疫治疗的疗效常受限于免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境（TME），这主要由肿瘤代谢重编程（Warburg效应）驱动，损害CD8(+) T细胞功能。靶向该代谢过程以恢复免疫是一种有前景的策略。鳖甲煎丸（BJJP）作为传统方剂，具有“软坚散结”之功效，在概念上与调节TME相符。然而，其在重编程肿瘤代谢以增强免疫治疗方面的作用仍不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨BJJP是否通过抑制Warburg效应增强抗肿瘤免疫，阐明其分子机制，并评估其与PD-L1阻断的协同作用。材料与方法：采用UHPLC-MS分析BJJP的主要成分，并评估其与PD-L1中和抗体联合治疗HCC的疗效。通过流式细胞术在体外和体内评估CD8(+) T细胞及肿瘤标志物。采用转录组学、代谢组学、Seahorse代谢分析、Western blotting、ELISA和免疫荧光染色来识别并验证BJJP的作用机制和靶点。通过慢病毒和siRNA转染、网络药理学及分子对接确认其靶向能力。结果：BJJP抑制HCC细胞增殖、生长和迁移，促进其凋亡，降低PD-L1表达，并增强肿瘤中CD8(+) T细胞的细胞毒性和浸润。BJJP与免疫治疗发挥协同作用，包括抑制肿瘤细胞增殖、增加免疫细胞浸润及提高治疗疗效。BJJP抑制HCC细胞糖酵解，缓解能量底物过度摄取，并减少微环境中乳酸积累，从而减轻CD8(+) T细胞耗竭。这种糖酵解代谢重编程与BJJP抑制HIF-1alpha-PI3K/AKT/mTOR轴的作用相关。此外，BJJP抑制下游NF-kappaB激活，下调CCL20，并缓解CCL20对CD8(+) T细胞的抑制作用。结论：BJJP靶向HIF-1alpha-PI3K/AKT/mTOR轴以重编程肿瘤糖酵解，减少CCL20分泌，增强CD8(+) T细胞免疫应答，并调节肿瘤微环境，从而发挥抗HCC作用。当与免疫治疗联合使用时，BJJP可提高治疗疗效，为临床治疗提供有价值的证据。
